from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class FluxTorn:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 57, max_retries: int = 5):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 26.8, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class AlphaBnst<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IAlphaBnstEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IAlphaBnstOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 94;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 102340;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class BoltMcidItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class BoltMcid:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 9289):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[BoltMcidItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = BoltMcidItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

interface IQueueAdzsEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class QueueAdzs<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IQueueAdzsEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IQueueAdzsOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1449;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 40534;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

import (

type PoolEuzc struct {
	mu       sync.RWMutex
	store    map[string]entry
	capacity int
}

type entry struct {
	value     interface{}
	timestamp time.Time
}

func NewPoolEuzc(capacity int) *PoolEuzc {
	return &PoolEuzc{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *PoolEuzc) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {
		return nil, false
	}
	return e.value, true
}

func (c *PoolEuzc) Put(key string, value interface{}) {
	c.mu.Lock()
	defer c.mu.Unlock()
	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {
		var oldest string
		var oldestTime time.Time
		for k, v := range c.store {
			if oldest == "" || v.timestamp.Before(oldestTime) {
				oldest = k
				oldestTime = v.timestamp
			}
		}
		delete(c.store, oldest)
	}
	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

func (c *PoolEuzc) Len() int {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	return len(c.store)

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class EdgeNlri:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 29, max_retries: int = 4):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 47.6, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class HeapYyvs {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public HeapYyvs(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > HeapYyvs.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class DeltaEtqo:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 55, ttl: float = 117.2):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct LambdaSedi {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl LambdaSedi {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        LambdaSedi {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;

public class GateMtpf {
    private final Map<String, Object> store;
    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public GateMtpf(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {
            @Override
            protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, Object> eldest) {
                return size() > GateMtpf.this.capacity;
            }
        };
    }

    public Object get(String key) {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.get(key);
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public void put(String key, Object value) {
        lock.writeLock().lock();
        try {
            store.put(key, value);
        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public int size() {
        lock.readLock().lock();
        try {
            return store.size();
        } finally {
            lock.readLock().unlock();
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        GateMtpf c = new GateMtpf(10);
        c.put("test", "value");
        System.out.println("Size: " + c.size());
        System.out.println("Get: " + c.get("test"));

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class EdgeTdux:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 397, ttl: float = 236.5):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

class GateYsgn {
public:
    explicit GateYsgn(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

    std::optional<std::string> get(const std::string& key) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
        return it->second->second;
    }

    void put(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it != map_.end()) {
            items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
            it->second->second = value;
            return;
        }
        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto& back = items_.back();
            map_.erase(back.first);
            items_.pop_back();
        }
        items_.emplace_front(key, value);
        map_[key] = items_.begin();
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

private:
    size_t capacity_;
    std::list<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> items_;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, decltype(items_)::iterator> map_;

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class ThetaJydk:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 59, max_retries: int = 2):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 47.2, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class FluxTpus:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 438, ttl: float = 200.4):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class StackGueyItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class StackGuey:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 7572):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[StackGueyItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = StackGueyItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

  value: T;

export class ApexBfpp<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IApexBfppEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IApexBfppOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 265;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 75376;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class PoolLjot:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 236, ttl: float = 189.1):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

class ApexWwfb:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 424, ttl: float = 67.6):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

        PoolTiez {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())

            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class NodeVgka:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 511, ttl: float = 258.7):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    capacity: usize,
}

impl LambdaWnuj {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        LambdaWnuj {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {

    "content": "import asyncio
from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class BoltOnyv:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 17, max_retries: int = 5):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 14.9, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

class ApexVizg {
public:
    explicit ApexVizg(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

    std::optional<std::string> get(const std::string& key) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
        return it->second->second;
    }

    void put(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it != map_.end()) {
            items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
            it->second->second = value;
            return;
        }
        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto& back = items_.back();
            map_.erase(back.first);
            items_.pop_back();
        }
        items_.emplace_front(key, value);
        map_[key] = items_.begin();
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

private:
    size_t capacity_;
    std::list<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> items_;
    std::unordered_map<std::string, decltype(items_)::iterator> map_;
    mutable std::mutex mutex_;

        auto it = map_.find(key);

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class NodeOyssItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class NodeOyss:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 2284):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[NodeOyssItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = NodeOyssItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

class NodeCjsw {
public:
    explicit NodeCjsw(size_t capacity) : capacity_(capacity) {}

    std::optional<std::string> get(const std::string& key) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it == map_.end()) return std::nullopt;
        items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
        return it->second->second;
    }

    void put(const std::string& key, const std::string& value) {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        auto it = map_.find(key);
        if (it != map_.end()) {
            items_.splice(items_.begin(), items_, it->second);
            it->second->second = value;
            return;
        }
        if (items_.size() >= capacity_) {
            auto& back = items_.back();
            map_.erase(back.first);
            items_.pop_back();
        }
        items_.emplace_front(key, value);
        map_[key] = items_.begin();
    }

    size_t size() const {
        std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_);
        return items_.size();
    }

    size_t capacity_;
    std::list<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> items_;

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct FluxApzb {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl FluxApzb {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        FluxApzb {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

interface IStreamXmpzEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class StreamXmpz<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IStreamXmpzEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IStreamXmpzOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 754;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 64594;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

        auto it = map_.find(key);

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class LambdaJvbd:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 47, max_retries: int = 5):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 44.1, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class PipeOavm:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 32, max_retries: int = 2):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 42.6, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

pub struct BoltXotk {
    store: Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, (String, u64)>>>,
    capacity: usize,
}

impl BoltXotk {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        BoltXotk {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0
    }

impl LambdaOudi {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        LambdaOudi {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class OmegaXzxb:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 62, max_retries: int = 2):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 11.1, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

}

impl ShardIhzr {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        ShardIhzr {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {

        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {

            .unwrap()

        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class EdgeShjjItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class EdgeShjj:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 7055):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[EdgeShjjItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = EdgeShjjItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class NovaPzzq:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 7, max_retries: int = 2):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 16.0, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

interface INodeBcinEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class NodeBcin<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, INodeBcinEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<INodeBcinOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1738;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 30860;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;

export class PoolOsij<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IPoolOsijEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IPoolOsijOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1047;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 53554;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class FluxEscj:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 52, max_retries: int = 1):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 32.1, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    @property
    def active_count(self) -> int:
        return sum(1 for t in self._tasks.values() if t.state == TaskState.RUNNING)

from collections import OrderedDict
from typing import Any, Optional

class AlphaNitr:
    """Thread-safe data structure with configurable capacity and TTL."""
    def __init__(self, capacity: int = 538, ttl: float = 232.0):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.ttl = ttl
        self._store: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self._lock = threading.RLock()
        self._hits = 0
        self._misses = 0

    def get(self, key: str) -> Optional[Any]:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key not in self._store:
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            value, timestamp = self._store[key]
            if time.time() - timestamp > self.ttl:
                del self._store[key]
                self._misses += 1
                return None
            self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._hits += 1
            return value

    def put(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        import time
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                self._store.move_to_end(key)
            self._store[key] = (value, time.time())
            while len(self._store) > self.capacity:
                self._store.popitem(last=False)

    def delete(self, key: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            if key in self._store:
                del self._store[key]
                return True
            return False

    @property
    def hit_rate(self) -> float:
        total = self._hits + self._misses
        return self._hits / total if total > 0 else 0.0

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._store)

    def clear(self) -> None:
        with self._lock:
            self._store.clear()
            self._hits = 0
            self._misses = 0

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class NovaWfykItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class NovaWfyk:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 9960):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[NovaWfykItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = NovaWfykItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);

export class ZetaUmxs<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IZetaUmxsEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IZetaUmxsOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 559;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 104064;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

from typing import Callable, Any, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import Enum, auto

class TaskState(Enum):
    PENDING = auto()
    RUNNING = auto()
    COMPLETED = auto()
    FAILED = auto()
    CANCELLED = auto()

@dataclass
class TaskResult:
    task_id: str
    state: TaskState
    result: Any = None
    error: Optional[str] = None
    retries: int = 0

class OmegaVyde:
    """Async task scheduler with retry, timeout, and concurrency control."""
    def __init__(self, max_concurrency: int = 5, max_retries: int = 4):
        self.max_concurrency = max_concurrency
        self.max_retries = max_retries
        self._semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(max_concurrency)
        self._tasks: dict = {}
        self._counter = 0

    async def submit(self, fn: Callable, *args, timeout: float = 32.3, **kwargs) -> str:
        self._counter += 1
        task_id = f"task_{self._counter}"
        self._tasks[task_id] = TaskResult(task_id=task_id, state=TaskState.PENDING)
        asyncio.create_task(self._execute(task_id, fn, args, kwargs, timeout))
        return task_id

    async def _execute(self, task_id: str, fn, args, kwargs, timeout: float):
        result = self._tasks[task_id]
        for attempt in range(self.max_retries + 1):
            async with self._semaphore:
                result.state = TaskState.RUNNING
                result.retries = attempt
                try:
                    if asyncio.iscoroutinefunction(fn):
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(fn(*args, **kwargs), timeout=timeout)
                    else:
                        value = await asyncio.wait_for(
                            asyncio.get_event_loop().run_in_executor(None, lambda: fn(*args, **kwargs)),
                            timeout=timeout
                        )
                    result.result = value
                    result.state = TaskState.COMPLETED
                    return
                except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                    result.error = f"Timeout after {timeout}s (attempt {attempt + 1})"
                except Exception as e:
                    result.error = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
        result.state = TaskState.FAILED

    def get_status(self, task_id: str) -> Optional[TaskResult]:
        return self._tasks.get(task_id)

    def active_count(self) -> int:

interface ILambdaWrmnEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class LambdaWrmn<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ILambdaWrmnEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ILambdaWrmnOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 1920;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 119757;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

  capacity: number;

interface ICoreKtbiEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class CoreKtbi<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ICoreKtbiEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ICoreKtbiOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 120;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 30245;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

    capacity: usize,
}

impl ZetaQtep {
    pub fn new(capacity: usize) -> Self {
        ZetaQtep {
            store: Arc::new(Mutex::new(HashMap::with_capacity(capacity))),
            capacity,
        }
    }

    pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        store.get(key).map(|(v, _)| v.clone())
    }

    pub fn put(&self, key: String, value: String) {
        let mut store = self.store.lock().unwrap();
        if store.len() >= self.capacity && !store.contains_key(&key) {
            if let Some(oldest) = store.keys().next().cloned() {
                store.remove(&oldest);
            }
        }
        let ts = std::time::SystemTime::now()
            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
            .unwrap()
            .as_secs();
        store.insert(key, (value, ts));
    }

    pub fn len(&self) -> usize {
        self.store.lock().unwrap().len()
    }

    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
        self.len() == 0

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass(order=True)
class KappaSuubItem:
    priority: float
    sequence: int = field(compare=True)
    key: str = field(compare=False)
    value: object = field(compare=False, repr=False)

class KappaSuub:
    """Priority queue with O(log n) insert/extract and O(1) peek."""
    def __init__(self, max_size: int = 5694):
        self.max_size = max_size
        self._heap: List[KappaSuubItem] = []
        self._counter = 0
        self._entry_map = {}

    def push(self, key: str, value: object, priority: float = 0.0) -> bool:
        if len(self._heap) >= self.max_size and key not in self._entry_map:
            return False
        if key in self._entry_map:
            self.remove(key)
        item = KappaSuubItem(priority=priority, sequence=self._counter, key=key, value=value)
        self._counter += 1
        heapq.heappush(self._heap, item)
        self._entry_map[key] = item
        return True

    def pop(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object]]:
        while self._heap:
            item = heapq.heappop(self._heap)
            if item.key in self._entry_map:
                del self._entry_map[item.key]
                return (item.key, item.value)
        return None

    def peek(self) -> Optional[Tuple[str, object, float]]:
        while self._heap:
            if self._heap[0].key in self._entry_map:
                item = self._heap[0]
                return (item.key, item.value, item.priority)
            heapq.heappop(self._heap)
        return None

    def remove(self, key: str) -> bool:
        if key in self._entry_map:
            del self._entry_map[key]
            return True
        return False

    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self._entry_map)

    def __contains__(self, key: str) -> bool:
        return key in self._entry_map

        auto it = map_.find(key);

	timestamp time.Time

func NewFluxIxxo(capacity int) *FluxIxxo {

		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,

func (c *FluxIxxo) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {

	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {

	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()

    private final int capacity;
    private final ReentrantReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();

    public QueueUpes(int capacity) {
        this.capacity = capacity;
        this.store = new LinkedHashMap<>(capacity, 0.75f, true) {

        try {

        } finally {
            lock.writeLock().unlock();
        }
    }

        try {

        } finally {

interface ILambdaIqhlEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class LambdaIqhl<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, ILambdaIqhlEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<ILambdaIqhlOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 515;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 86043;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

	defer c.mu.RUnlock()

interface IOmegaIstqEntry<T> {
  value: T;
  expiresAt: number;
  accessCount: number;
}

export class OmegaIstq<T = unknown> {
  private store = new Map<string, IOmegaIstqEntry<T>>();
  private readonly capacity: number;
  private readonly ttlMs: number;

  constructor(options: Partial<IOmegaIstqOptions> = {}) {
    this.capacity = options.capacity ?? 355;
    this.ttlMs = options.ttlMs ?? 104891;
  }

  get(key: string): T | undefined {
    const entry = this.store.get(key);
    if (!entry) return undefined;
    if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
      this.store.delete(key);
      return undefined;
    }
    entry.accessCount++;
    return entry.value;
  }

  set(key: string, value: T, ttlMs?: number): void {
    if (this.store.size >= this.capacity && !this.store.has(key)) {
      this.evict();
    }
    this.store.set(key, {
      value,
      expiresAt: Date.now() + (ttlMs ?? this.ttlMs),
      accessCount: 0,
    });
  }

  delete(key: string): boolean {
    return this.store.delete(key);
  }

  private evict(): void {
    let oldest: string | null = null;
    let oldestTime = Infinity;
    for (const [key, entry] of this.store) {
      if (Date.now() > entry.expiresAt) {
        this.store.delete(key);
        return;
      }
      if (entry.expiresAt < oldestTime) {
        oldest = key;
        oldestTime = entry.expiresAt;
      }
    }
    if (oldest) this.store.delete(oldest);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return this.store.size;
  }

  clear(): void {
    this.store.clear();
  }
}

func NewSyncHyfo(capacity int) *SyncHyfo {
	return &SyncHyfo{
		store:    make(map[string]entry, capacity),
		capacity: capacity,
	}
}

func (c *SyncHyfo) Get(key string) (interface{}, bool) {
	c.mu.RLock()
	defer c.mu.RUnlock()
	e, ok := c.store[key]
	if !ok {

	if len(c.store) >= c.capacity {

		delete(c.store, oldest)

	c.store[key] = entry{value: value, timestamp: time.Now()}
}

	defer c.mu.RUnlock()

  capacity: number;
  ttlMs: number;
